note: Pathankot district was carved from Gurdaspur on 27-07-2011, after the Census-2011 frame; Census 2011 still counts it inside Gurdaspur (subdistricts incl. Pathankot, Dhar Kalan)
Tarn Taran carved out of Amritsar in 2006 (Wikipedia district article; Census-2011 Tarn Taran = Tarn Taran, Patti, Khadur Sahib tehsils)
Census-2011 name Shahid Bhagat Singh Nagar; renamed Shahid Bhagat Singh Nagar in 2008 (same district: Nawanshahr + Balachaur tehsils)
SAS Nagar (Mohali) carved in April 2006 from Ropar (Mohali, Kharar tehsils) and Patiala (Dera Bassi tehsil) (Wikipedia district article; Census-2011 subdistricts Kharar, SAS Nagar, Dera Bassi)
Fazilka district was carved from Firozpur on 27-07-2011, after the Census-2011 frame; Census 2011 still counts it inside Firozpur (subdistricts incl. Fazilka, Abohar, Jalalabad)
Barnala carved out of Sangrur on 19-11-2006 (Wikipedia district article; Census-2011 Barnala = Barnala, Tapa)
Dera Bassi tehsil of Patiala went to the new SAS Nagar district in 2006 (order AC 112 Dera Bassi = Dera Bassi Tehsil)
